# WowGuitar

> Free browser-based music tools: microphone tuners (guitar, ukulele, violin, cello, bass, chromatic), an online metronome with tap tempo, and a guitar and piano chord chart with sound. No app, no sign-up; available in 15 languages. Microphone audio is analysed on the device and never uploaded.

## Tools (English)
- [Guitar tuner](https://www.wowguitar.com/en/guitar-tuner/): standard tuning, Drop D, Open G, DADGAD, half-step down
- [Ukulele tuner](https://www.wowguitar.com/en/ukulele-tuner/): GCEA
- [Violin tuner](https://www.wowguitar.com/en/violin-tuner/): GDAE
- [Cello tuner](https://www.wowguitar.com/en/cello-tuner/): CGDA
- [Bass tuner](https://www.wowguitar.com/en/bass-tuner/): 4-string EADG
- [Chromatic tuner](https://www.wowguitar.com/en/chromatic-tuner/): any instrument, A4 430–450 Hz
- [Metronome](https://www.wowguitar.com/en/metronome/): 30–300 BPM, tap tempo, time signatures, subdivisions
- [Guitar and piano chords](https://www.wowguitar.com/en/chord-lookup/): fingerings, piano inversions, transpose
